GEORGE TASK FORMAT: 1

STACK: greenfield-express-v1
TASK: P2 — Implement task API
KIND: implementation

GOAL

Implement meaningful in-memory task API behavior.

INSPECT

- current application source
- package scripts

REQUIREMENTS

- R1: GET /health returns JSON {"status":"ok"}.
- R2: POST /tasks accepts a JSON title after trimming, returns 201 and {id,title,done:false}.
- R3: Missing, non-string, blank, or over-120-character titles return 400 JSON with an error string.
- R4: GET /tasks returns the created tasks in insertion order.
- R5: PATCH /tasks/:id accepts a boolean done value and returns the updated task; unknown IDs and invalid done values return 404 and 400 respectively.

WORKFLOW

W1 — Inspect current application behavior
Covers: R1, R2, R3, R4, R5
Depends on: none

Inspect before editing.

W2 — Add routes and validation
Covers: R1, R2, R3, R4, R5
Depends on: W1

Keep all state in the app factory so tests are isolated.

VALIDATION

V1 — Focused API test
Covers: R1, R2, R3, R4, R5
Run: npm test

STOP CONDITIONS

- S1: Do not claim completion while V1 is failing or unexecuted.

PERMISSIONS

- Workspace: autonomous
- Network: ask
